title: ENKIDETIDET E YAKOBO
paragraphs: Ore pee elo Yakobo Syria, neirrag enkewarie nabo Betel. Ore teine netum enkidetidet. Nedol olkedet obaiki shumata o enkop. Nepuo ilmalaika te shumata o ti abori. Ore te shumata olkedet, neitashe

Olaitoriani, nejoki, “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e Abraham papaai lino, nara sii Enkai e Isaak, naa ore ena kop naa ninye irragie, ekaaisho nanu iyie tenebo o eishoi ino. Naa kebayu eishoi ino anaa enterit enkop naa aiponari aibulaa aidapashakino enkop te nkalo o loontolu, o tenkalo o loosaen, o te nkalo e moikuape o te nkalo e kopikop; naa te iyie tenebo eishoi ino emayian iloshon le nkop pooki ate. Ing’ura atii nanu tenebo iyie naa kaarrip iyie te pooki wueji naba anaa enilo, naaitoki arrinyu ena kop.”
